commentary: Benchmark indices show headline resilience clearing 23,650 on institutional FII buying, yet our breadth score sits at a selective 42 with the deterministic gate flagged WEAK. Under Stan Weinstein's stage analysis and William O'Neil's market-direction doctrine, broad participation must confirm major index thrusts. When underlying market breadth remains narrow, leaders can decouple briefly, but speculative rallies frequently fail at overhead supply. Disciplined operators do not chase unconfirmed momentum. Livermore's cardinal rule demands aligning exposure with true general market health while Minervini's progressive exposure dictates keeping position sizing constrained until Stage 2 leadership expands decisively across sectors.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis, Darvas Box & Livermore Market Discipline

21STCENMGM.technical: Displays a clean 20-day high breakout on 3.69x volume expansion, confirming a Minervini Trend Template alignment above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. Price action cleared trailing annual resistance, demonstrating explosive short-term relative strength, though low liquidity introduces slippage risk.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Capital market investment firm with erratic history turned profitable in Q1 FY27 with net profit of ₹9 crore. High promoter holding of 64.4% offers stability, but trailing ROE of -57% and balance sheet volatility fail O'Neil's demand for sustained, high-quality institutional return metrics.
21STCENMGM.risk: Failure to hold the 51.98 support invalidates the breakout; Minervini discipline requires immediate stop-loss execution to curb tail risk in volatile microcaps.

63MOONS.technical: Consolidating tightly within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot at 969.72, holding above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. Constructive base-building shows two aligned swing lows with MACD positive, but overhead supply from prior swing highs limits velocity.
63MOONS.fundamental: While subsidiary 63SATS drove a 350% revenue surge, consolidated operations suffered a ₹39.7 crore net loss in Q1 FY27. Negligible debt and 45.6% promoter holding are positives, but low 1.5% ROE fails CANSLIM profitability filters.
63MOONS.risk: Violation of the 859.60 stop-loss level breaches the structural pivot low, requiring an immediate disciplined exit.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Forming a double-bottom base above key EMAs with RSI at 56, showing constructive base progression. A long lower shadow confirms intraday rejection of lows, but the setup remains inside a broader Stage 1 accumulation range requiring decisive pivot clearance.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Financials reveal sharp contraction with Q1 FY27 revenue falling 55% YoY and net profit dropping 25.5% to ₹1 crore. Subdued margins and weak 3% ROE fail O'Neil's CANSLIM standards despite 41.5% promoter backing.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A break below 103.98 invalidates the double bottom structure; Minervini risk protocol enforces an automatic cut.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Trading constructively within 1.5% of its 458.41 pivot, respecting upward-sloping 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. Momentum is confirmed by RSI at 63 and a bullish MACD histogram, forming an orderly handle-like contraction.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 19% to ₹703 crore, but PAT contracted 4.1% YoY to ₹50 crore due to margin pressures. Modest ROCE of 12% and lack of net earnings growth prevent leadership qualification under O'Neil's C-criterion.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Slipping below 420.75 breaches the consolidation floor, demanding strict stop enforcement to preserve capital.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Forming an immaculate double bottom above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, with price knocking on the 1003.40 neckline pivot. Clean volatility contraction and positive MACD support strong relative strength against the pharmaceutical peer group.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM fundamentals: Q2 FY27 standalone PAT surged 180% YoY to ₹65.8 crore as revenue jumped 46.8% to ₹613 crore. Operating leverage lifted EBITDA margins to 22.2%, propelled by high-margin CDMO and xanthine volume expansions.
AARTIPHARM.risk: A drop below 914.95 invalidates the double-bottom pivot low, triggering a compulsory stop.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Textbook Stage 2 trend structure above all key moving averages, consolidating tightly within 1.5% of its 1873.87 pivot. RSI at 66 and positive MACD confirm institutional demand and dominant relative strength as an index heavyweight.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Q2 consolidated revenue expanded 23.7% YoY to ₹11,340 crore with PAT rising 17.3% to ₹3,682 crore, prompting full-year guidance upgrades. Industry-leading 72%+ port EBITDA margins and BBB credit upgrade reflect institutional quality, though EPS growth falls just short of the 25% CANSLIM threshold.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Breaching 1774.37 violates the swing support; cut the trade immediately to protect capital.
